Corollary
[weak scalar heat maximum principle] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0055 ↗ lem:chow-ii-spatial-maximum-dini ↗ cor:chow-ii-dini-monotonicity 1. ch10:10.31\group Dini derivative tools

If $\partial _tu\le \Delta _{g(t)}u$ on a closed manifold, then $u(x,t)\le \max _xu(x,0)$.
Proof

\sketch At a spatial maximizer, $\Delta u\le 0$. The spatial-maximum lemma gives $d^+f/dt\le 0$ for $f(t)=\max _xu(x,t)$, and the monotonicity corollary applies.

□
